nameservers.description: Used to statically set the nameservers for the machine.

pod.description: Used to provide static pod definitions to be run by the kubelet directly bypassing the kube-apiserver.

extra_args.description: Extra arguments to supply to kube-proxy.

image.description: The container image used in the kube-proxy manifest.

is_disabled.description: Disable kube-proxy deployment on cluster bootstrap.

mode.description: The container image used in the kube-proxy manifest.

proxy.description: Represents the kube proxy configuration options.

ca.description: CA registry certificate to add the list of trusted certificates. Non base64 encoded.

client_identity_crt.description: Enable mutual TLS authentication with the registry. Non base64 encoded client certificate.

client_identity_key.description: Enable mutual TLS authentication with the registry. Non base64 encoded client key.

identity_token.description: Identity token for optional registry authentication.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS server certificate verification (not recommended)..

configs.description:
Specifies TLS & auth configuration for HTTPS image registries. The meaning of each auth_field is the same with the corresponding field in .docker/config.json.

Key description: The first segment of an image identifier, with ‘docker.io’ being default one. To catch any registry names not specified explicitly, use ‘*’.

mirrors.description: Specifies mirror configuration for each registry.

sysctls.description: Used to configure the machine’s sysctls.

sysfs.description: Used to configure the machine’s sysctls.
